signin.heading: Sign in to your Xbox account
signin.instruction: Open this page on your phone and enter the code:
signin.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in…
signin.expiresIn: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes.
signin.keepOpen: Leave this screen open until you have finished on the phone.
signin.scan: Or scan it with your phone

errors.declined: Sign-in was declined on the phone.
errors.bad_code: Microsoft did not recognise this sign-in. Start again.
errors.devicecode_failed: The sign-in could not be started.
errors.no_xbox_account: This Microsoft account has no Xbox profile yet. Create one at xbox.com, then sign in again.
errors.child_account: This is a child account. An adult has to add it to a family first.
errors.region_unsupported: Xbox Live is not available in this account's country.
errors.account_banned: This Xbox account has been suspended.
errors.terms_not_accepted: This account has not accepted the Xbox terms of service.
errors.account_maintenance: The Xbox service is under maintenance. Try again later.
errors.proof_of_possession_required: Microsoft asked for a sign-in this device cannot do.
errors.xsts_failed: Xbox Live did not grant access. Try again.
errors.reauth_required: The Xbox sign-in expired. Sign in again.
errors.refresh_failed: The sign-in could not be renewed. Try again.
errors.not_signed_in: No Xbox account is signed in.
errors.offering_unavailable: Game Pass Ultimate is not available in this country.
errors.streaming_token_failed: Streaming access could not be obtained. Try again.
errors.transfer_token_failed: The game could not be joined. Try again.
errors.gssv_failed: The Xbox service did not answer. Try again.
errors.catalog_unavailable: The Game Pass catalogue cannot be read right now.
errors.sigl_unavailable: That list is not available right now.
errors.session_failed: The game could not be started.
errors.provision_timeout: The server did not become ready in time.
errors.exchange_timeout: The server did not answer the connection.
errors.no_first_frame: The game did not start sending a picture.
errors.slow: This is taking longer than it should.

library.partial: Some game names are still missing.

stream.queued: You are in a queue. This can take a few minutes.
stream.trial: This game can be played for {minutes} minutes.
stream.queuedHint: You can leave and try again later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityHint: an upper limit; the server may send less
settings.resolutionHint: on a weak link a smaller picture beats a harder-compressed one
settings.gameLanguageHint: chosen when the game starts; it cannot change while it runs
